title: Bounded constructible finite-coefficient étale category
statement: The full subcategory $D^b_c(X_{\Et},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)\subseteq D(X_{\Et},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$ consists of the objects with only finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, all constructible in the sense of Definition [pur713-def-finite-constructible] for $\tau=\Et$. Morphisms are those of $D(X_{\Et},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$.
